transcript.text: Good morning everyone. We need to sort out the power-management plan for tomorrow's 0800 to 1400 period. We have three two-hour blocks available: 0800-1000, 1000-1200, and 1200-1400. The facilities shop, clinic, and protected-network section all need an approved block or operating control before the period begins. I'd like to hear from each section on which block they need and why, so we can work out a plan for the morning coordination board to review before I sign off on it.

transcript.text: Col. Harper, I need to flag something that hasn't made it onto the coordination-board slide yet. This morning I confirmed that the east distribution panel must be taken offline for the generator load test from exactly 0800 to 1000. The electrical contractor's signed work sheet is still in the facilities binder and hasn't been added to the slide. This means the facilities shop has a hard requirement on the 0800-1000 block.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Col. Harper, I also need to flag something that hasn't made it onto the power plan yet. Yesterday after the clinic report was submitted, I confirmed with our pharmacy technician that the clinic's vaccine refrigerator must remain on generator-backed power during the exact 1000-1200 block while its primary feed is transferred. This pharmacy note was received after yesterday's clinic report and is not yet reflected in the base power plan, so the clinic has a hard requirement on the 1000-1200 block.
